title: Growing up abroad, Ukrainian child refugees redefine the meaning of home
summary: When six-year-old Matvii Dovhan sees blue and yellow, he proudly tells his mother: Ukraine!" Matvii moved to Canada from the Russian-occupied city of Enerhodar in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia Oblast when he was three. He can’t remember much from that time. His family never planned to leave.

title: Fuel depot in Azov, Russia reportedly in flames following Ukrainian drone attacks
summary: Ukrainian monitoring channels reported that an oil depot in Azov, in Russia's Rostov Oblast, about 142 km (88 miles) from the Ukrainian border, was on fire at approximately 4 a.m. local time.

title: Pro-Russian, autonomous Moldovan region to hold runoff elections
summary: In August 2025, Gagauzia's leader, Evghenia Gutul, was sentenced to seven years in prison for systematically bringing funds from Russia to Moldova to support the pro-Russian Shor Party.

title: Europe will 'closely engage' in peace negotiations between Russia, Ukraine, von der Leyen says
summary: The European Commission president's statement comes days after European leaders agreed on Nov. 13 that EU institutions and five European countries will jointly represent Europe in negotiations aimed at ending Russia's war against Ukraine.

title: Ukrainian drone attacks 'neutralized' 55% of Russia's oil refining capacity, Zelensky says
summary: "In total, we have already neutralized more than 55% of Russia’s oil refining capacity," Zelensky said, citing a report by Major General Mykhailo Drapatyi. "This is a fitting response to Russia’s refusal to de-escalate and to their strikes against our energy infrastructure."
